answer: The signal graph is validated at intake and the kernel frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and cipher anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 25 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 3884 account sybil into a 11 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
